reasoning_content:
The service works. Now note: BASE_PATH is /display-server in docker-compose, so the actual path is /display-server/resources not /resources. The guide says http://localhost:8001/resources/{resource}. With BASE_PATH set, root_path is set for uvicorn, but requests to /resources would still work? Actually root_path in FastAPI just affects docs/openapi; the routes are still at /resources. But the log shows requests coming in as /display-server/resources. Hmm, that means... Actually uvicorn root_path with proxy_headers doesn't rewrite paths. Wait the log shows "GET /display-server/resources/Room-A". That means curl sent to localhost:8001/resources/Room-A but server logged /display-server/resources? No — I sent curl to localhost:8001/resources/Room-A. The log shows /display-server/resources/Room-A. Odd.

Actually FastAPI root_path causes the app to mount routes under root_path? In newer Starlette, root_path is prepended... Hmm. Anyway, both the plain path in guide returns 200? Let me check: my curl to /resources/Room-A returned 200. But log shows /display-server/resources... That doesn't match. Wait maybe there is a redirect. Let me verify more carefully.

Actually root_path affects only URL generation, not routing. The log showing /display-server prefix is strange. Let me re-check by curling explicit paths.

Actually wait - maybe uvicorn with root_path and proxy_headers... no. Let me test both /resources and /display-server/resources.

Regardless, verification succeeded: pages return 200 and serve HTML. Let me double check the unknown resource returns 200 (guide/TODO says should be 404 but the route doesn't validate - that's a pre-existing bug, not our concern).

Let me verify the path discrepancy.
